notes: This is a bounded prospect-research batch, not a complete UAE directory or a claim that every listed business needs a replacement website.

Inventory totals are the retrieved page's advertised result counts, not independently verified sale-ready stock. Search indexes, languages and marketplace profiles can show different snapshots; do not sum them.
A null website records an unsuccessful bounded domain match, not proof that the company has no website. Existing sites need a visual and task-based audit before qualification.

Browser requests to The Dealers Point and Al Basma were blocked by this research environment. That is not evidence of a customer-facing website failure. No screenshots or rendered mobile acceptance are claimed.
Public business-contact source URLs identify where to verify a channel. They are not marketing consent. No message was sent and prior contact history was not inspected.

leads.name: Al Aayan Used Cars
leads.evidenceNote: The retrieved English DubiCars dealer page reports 34 results. Exact-name research surfaced marketplace profiles without a confidently matched independent domain; other profiles show different totals.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: An owned dealership catalogue with consistent available-stock information and a car-specific enquiry path.
leads.nextAction: Confirm legal business identity, official domain status, showroom address and available cars. Check private contact history before approving the three-demo package.

leads.name: Al Fareed Used Cars
leads.evidenceNote: The dealer profile reports 46 results. A similarly named result at a different Dubai marketplace URL was not assumed to be a separate business or the same account.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: A standalone mixed-stock showroom and direct vehicle enquiries rather than a marketplace-only public identity.
leads.nextAction: Resolve any related marketplace profiles, verify independent-domain status and available stock, then qualify one account rather than cloning duplicates.

leads.name: Al Basma Motors
leads.evidenceNote: An independent dealership site exists and the marketplace reports 50 results. Limited extracted website text and an environment-blocked browser request do not establish poor UX or a broken site.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Assess whether a more stock-led mobile showroom would improve the existing journey; this remains an unverified redesign hypothesis.
leads.nextAction: Audit the actual mobile home, inventory, detail and enquiry flow. Qualify only if a concrete, useful improvement over the current site is demonstrated.

leads.name: The Dealers Point
leads.evidenceNote: The marketplace reports 32 results. Extracted homepage arrival cards repeatedly show an ask-price label; this is a content observation, not proof of a visual defect or a mistake in the dealer's pricing policy.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: More consistent stock, price/request-price information and car-specific enquiries across the owned site and marketplace presence.
leads.nextAction: Compare the same available cars across the live site and marketplace, confirm intended pricing policy, and capture an actual mobile journey before approving three concepts.

leads.name: F1rst Motors
leads.evidenceNote: The user nominated this business for a redesign review. Its independent luxury inventory page reports 59 available cars and already offers catalogue functionality. No independent visual-quality conclusion was reached in this research.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: A restrained, mobile-first luxury showroom concept emphasizing vehicle photography and a clear appointment/enquiry path, subject to comparison with the existing site.
leads.nextAction: Audit the live site and test whether the existing three template designs fit the brand without a bespoke rebuild. Do not assume purchasing intent, budget, dissatisfaction or permission to use its media.

leads.name: Al Hamoor Al Thahabi Used Cars
leads.evidenceNote: The Sharjah dealer-profile URL reports 25 results; some listing location labels differ. The account needs location verification and is below the initial 30-ad screening target.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Potential independent stock catalogue, but qualify business scale and actual showroom identity first.
leads.nextAction: Verify the physical showroom, domain and active unique cars. Keep out of the automatic build queue unless the owner approves an exception.

leads.name: Car Finder 360
leads.evidenceNote: 24 marketplace results and an independent website with existing enquiry/finance journeys. Neither substantial enough stock nor a website deficiency has been established for the main campaign gate.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Review only if a concrete catalogue/mobile opportunity appears; do not propose features already present as if they were missing.
leads.nextAction: Keep on reserve, verify unique available stock and audit the existing journey before any speculative build.
